Timeline:
- 3 days out: re-read the Lincoln International job posting and their public materials. Write down the three things the role needs most and map one story to each.

- 1 day out: prepare 5 to 6 STAR stories, each with a specific result and a number. Practice your "why Lincoln" and "why this role" answers until they run under 90 seconds.
